cohort: The study included 196 term parturients undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: Greater abdominal circumference and BMI were associated with faster sensory onset and higher block height, and vertebral column length and VCL/AC2 correlated significantly with anaesthetic spread parameters.
mod_finding: The study was performed in parturients undergoing elective caesarean section to investigate factors influencing spinal anaesthesia spread.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken around the time of spinal anaesthesia administration for elective caesarean section.
